operators#

Operator roles (#215).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

object Money does Adding<Money, Money>, Comparing<Money> { ... }
total + fee;            // total.plus(fee)
total < limit;          // total.order(limit) == Order.less

Description#

Operator roles (#215). An object that declares one of these roles gives the matching operator a meaning for its values:

The first parameter is the type of the right operand, the second the type of the result, so Instant + Duration can give an Instant and Instant - Instant a Duration: one object may declare a role several times with different operands. The right operand must have exactly that type; nothing converts implicitly. <, <=, >, >= use compare.Comparing; == and != stay structural. The roles are nominal: an object with a plus action but no does Adding<…> gets no +.
